observations: The SPLiT paper is publicly available as a PLOS Computational Biology article published 2026-08-25 and explicitly lists S1 Code as Code.zip; this run still did not recover the ZIP payload/source files through the available read-only transport.

Hidden semi-Markov/explicit-duration models are used in neuroscience because ordinary HMMs impose geometric sojourn times; Shappell et al. 2019 explicitly motivate HSMMs for more accurate brain-state duration/state-change inference.

An explicit-duration HMM framework has also been validated for inferring latent attentional states from simultaneous behavioral measures, supporting duration as a potentially useful state-inference signal rather than merely an engineering convenience.
These sources motivate explicit duration as a hypothesis. They do not establish that explicit duration improves dormant-memory admission under representation drift.

design.purpose: Isolate the value and failure modes of explicit sojourn-duration priors for distinguishing temporary latent silence from persistent context-change transients, then test whether utility-aware dormant-memory admission improves downstream decision utility.
design.stream_family: Synthetic 3-state observation streams: stable, temporary latent silence, and persistent-context-change transient. Five-dimensional correlated Gaussian change evidence approximates residual/subspace/covariance/trace/entropy signals. This is not a source-exact SPLiT simulation and does not reuse O/downstream/other-worker state.
design.calibration: Gaussian emissions and state-duration distributions fit on 120 disjoint matched streams. A separate 50 matched-stream set fit posterior calibration. A third disjoint mixed-duration validation set selected a conservative utility margin. Held-out evaluation used 24 streams per duration family, 2500 steps/stream.

duration_models.fixed: geometric/constant hazard per state fitted from mean calibration sojourn
duration_models.explicit: state-specific gamma sojourn distributions fitted from calibration durations and converted to run-length dependent hazards
duration_models.shrink: 75% explicit-duration hazard + 25% geometric hazard; shrinkage selected on disjoint mixed-duration validation by mean Brier score

design.memory_decision: Within a 12-step candidate-admission window, compare a conservative silence-posterior threshold with an expected-utility gate. Utility calibration estimates future benefit of retaining a temporarily silent direction versus stale-interference cost after persistent change. A posterior-calibrated conservative positive-utility margin was selected only on disjoint validation streams.
design.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals over held-out streams; all reported differences are bounded to this synthetic family.

interpretation: Explicit state-duration structure can improve posterior calibration when held-out durations resemble calibration or differ moderately, consistent with HSMM motivation in neuroscience.
That gain is not automatically a downstream memory benefit: matched-family utility improvement versus geometric hazard was small and its CI crossed zero.

When duration semantics are adversarially reversed, explicit duration becomes actively harmful: Brier worsens and decision utility falls significantly. Duration must therefore be treated as uncertain context, not hard truth.
A geometric-shrinkage mixture is a useful robustness control but is not sufficient under full duration-role reversal.
Utility awareness helps only when posterior calibration and a conservative margin are included. The naive expected-benefit-minus-cost sign rule over-admits stale directions.
The best current mechanism hypothesis is uncertainty-aware cause inference + duration-model regularization + cost-sensitive memory admission, with explicit fallbacks when duration statistics drift.
limits: Synthetic Gaussian change-evidence streams, not a source-exact SPLiT/HSMM/LCNet reproduction and not a biological memory model.

Duration and emission fitting used synthetic cause labels in calibration to isolate the causal contribution of duration modeling; this is favorable to the explicit-duration model and does not solve unsupervised cause discovery.
The utility function is a transparent synthetic proxy for post-silence recovery benefit and stale-memory interference; absolute utility magnitudes are not empirical neuroscience quantities.
The prior run's strong unsupervised GMM cause detector was not source-exactly reconstructed here; comparisons are within this new controlled family only.
SPLiT S1 Code.zip source payload remains unrecovered through the available read-only transport.

candidate_update.positive_scope: Explicit sojourn structure improves posterior calibration in matched/moderate duration regimes; a separately calibrated conservative utility margin improves memory-admission utility in high-hazard and adversarial duration tests.
candidate_update.negative_boundary: Hard explicit duration is brittle under duration-role reversal and does not produce a reliable utility gain over a geometric hazard. Naive expected-utility gating can be worse than a conservative probability threshold.

bounded_audit.exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Replace the single fitted duration prior with a hierarchical uncertainty-aware duration ensemble (explicit-duration components plus geometric/heavy-tail fallback) whose mixture weights are updated from posterior predictive fit without event labels. Evaluate whether it detects duration-distribution shift early enough to avoid the duration-swapped failure while preserving matched calibration gains. Keep a separately calibrated cost-sensitive admission margin and compare against the prior run's unsupervised multivariate cause-likelihood baseline, fixed-hazard baseline, and shrinkage control. Then reintroduce actual PAST/GROUSE-like and Oja-like dormant-subspace trackers so utility is measured as post-silence recovery and post-switch interference rather than only a synthetic event utility proxy. Preserve disjoint calibration, held-out hazard/duration shifts, reliability/calibration metrics, admission/release precision-recall, exact tested scope, and nonempty frontier.
